name: Čakule
iz Kužine
hero.lead: A private chef in Istria. I cook in your home or villa, for up to six guests. The season sets the menu.

intro.title: Local, in season.
paragraphs: My meal planning starts at the market. I buy from local growers and from the fishmonger, and I choose Croatian meat when I can.
I cook with care to bring restaurant-level preparation into your home. The plates are precise and the service follows your pace.

how.title: You choose the date. I cook.
how.lead: Tell me the date and the number of guests. We agree a menu, and I do the rest.

steps.title: Choose a date and a place
steps.text: Tell me when and where: a home, a villa, a terrace. I bring my own knives and basic equipment.

steps.title: We plan the menu
steps.text: We talk about what you like, allergies, and the occasion. I suggest a menu, and you confirm it.

steps.title: I cook, you enjoy
steps.text: I arrive early, cook, and serve. You stay at the table.

included.title: What the price covers
included.lead: One price for the evening: food, service, cleaning, and drinks on request.
included.note: The price is agreed by the number of guests and the menu you choose.

rows.detail: I choose the ingredients that morning.

rows.item: A menu adjusted for allergies and dietary needs
rows.detail: We agree it before the evening.

statement.label: From the kitchen
statement.text: The season sets the menu. What is best at the market that morning is what will be on the plate that evening.

faq.title: Good to know before you book.
faq.lead: For unanswered questions, ask me on Take a Chef. I respond within 24 hours.

items.q: How many guests do you cook for?
items.a: Up to six. For larger groups, ask me and I will tell you what is possible.
I cook across Istria. Outside Istria, travel costs are discussed and agreed in advance.

items.q: What do you need in the kitchen?
items.a: An ordinary home kitchen with a stove and an oven is enough. If something specific is needed, I'll let you know in advance.
Tell me about allergies and dietary needs before we set the menu. I adjust the menu for both.
Usually three to four hours, depending on the number of courses and the pace of the evening.
You book through my Take a Chef profile. Choose a date and send an enquiry there, and we arrange the details afterwards.

items.q: Do you leave the kitchen clean?
items.a: Yes. I wash up and clean the kitchen before I go.

cta.title: Your dinner starts with one enquiry.
cta.lead: Check availability, choose a date, and send me a few details. I'll reply with a menu proposal.
cta.note: Bookings go through my Take a Chef profile.
